posts.author: Clown
posts.title: We Are All Ears!
posts.html:
Got a suggestion to improve the server? We are always wanting to hear feedback and suggestions into how we can create a better gaming experience for all of us.

We really do read these posts and treat each one seriously, if we like your idea then you may even see it implimented into the script in the next update!
